description:
-= Office =-
You're now in an office.

You see a locker. The locker is empty, what a horrible day!

You need an unblocked exit? You should try going north. You don't like doors? Why not try going west, that entranceway is unblocked.

There is a disk on the floor.
objective: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First of all, you could, like, lift the disk from the floor of the office. After that, you can place the disk inside the locker. And if you do that, you're the winner!
